items.prompt: $48 is shared in the ratio 2:3. How much does the child with 3 parts get?
items.misconceptionCode: A ratio of 3:2 means 3/2 of the whole.

items.prompt: In the ratio 2:3, how many equal parts is the whole split into?
Work out both shares when $48 is shared in the ratio 2:3, showing the one-part step.
$60 is shared in the ratio 2:3. How much does the child with 3 parts get?
3 parts out of a whole of 5 parts is what fraction of the whole?
Explain why the 3-part share of $48 cannot be $72.
items.answer: $72 is more than the whole $48: the whole is 5 parts, so 3 parts is 3/5 of $48, which is $28.80.
